<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/api/gift-lists/{postId}/guests"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



For a young child or anyone else who isn't on Famlin. Any participant
may add one (at most 30 per list) and becomes its manager — the only
one who adds, edits and reorders its wishes, via the item endpoints
with `guestId`. Guests never take part in the Secret Santa draw. When
the manager leaves or is removed, the guest's wishlist goes too.
Server feature `giftListGuests`.
